title: Underlying randomized tree
statement: Let $\Omega$ and $\alpha$ be types, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f:(\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to\Omega)\to\alpha$. Every randomized decision tree that computes $f$ for every seed determines a randomized decision tree with possible error, retaining the same seed space, seed law, and seed-indexed trees.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from product inputs to $\alpha$
The input is a randomized decision tree computing $f$ for every seed
